    LIVE SUMMARY

    Billing dashboard

    All money shown in PKR · no conversion.

    iSaved selling prices create month-specific bill snapshots beginning at their effective Pakistan local month. New monthly bills default to the 5th; saved custom due dates are preserved. Actual receipts apply to the selected month first; excess may be allocated as credit to later generated bills. Credit is not a second payment. Archived customers receive no new bills. Editing a price does not rewrite older snapshots, and no late penalty is invented. Expected package margin and provider cost are estimates, not collected cash.

                                                  📅 Monthly Billing Cycle
                                                  
        
      
                                                  
      
                                                  
        
                                                  Run one billing cycle for a month: each active customer gets their package bill plus previous arrears, minus advance credit. Rates lock per bill — later price changes never alter this cycle. A month can only be cycled once.
                                                  
        
                                                  
        
                                                  
          
          
          
        
                                                  
        
                                                  
        
        
                                                  
      
                                                  
    
                                                  
                                                    
  
    
                                                  
      
                                                  
        
                                                  🛠️ Complaint Register
                                                  
        
      
                                                  
      
                                                  
        
                                                  One register for every fault: who reported it, when it was fixed, and how long the customer was down. Resolving a complaint fills its downtime automatically (resolved − reported); edit any field inline.

                                                  🔧 Field Tickets — Lineman Worklist
                                                  
        
      
                                                  
      
                                                  
        
                                                  Structured field faults: who fixed what, with which lineman, and how much material left the store. Resolving a ticket logs its materials; Billed to Customer adds the amounts to that customer's pending ticket charges (never to bills).

                                                  How many hours each customer was down, and how many hours the whole network lost per cause. Zone-wide faults count toward the network breakdown, not toward any single customer.

                                                  One month, four parts: totals, per-customer frequency, cause breakdown, and the full chronological log. Zone-wide faults count toward the network totals, not toward any single customer.

This report only summarizes the ledger — it never changes bills, payments, expenses, or customers.
